1.d4 d5 2.c4 c6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.e3 e6 5.Nf3.strategy: Attacks the knight a second time: the c3 knight and the bishop both hit e4, defended only by the d5 pawn, so Black must support, trade or move it. If Black trades on c3, White recaptures towards the centre and gets a broad pawn centre at the price of doubled c-pawns.

Supports the knight on e4 with the f-pawn, building a wall of pawns on c6, d5, e6 and f5 and a firm outpost for the knight. The cost is lasting: the e5 square is left to White, and the c8-bishop stays shut in behind its own pawns.
1.d4 d5 2.c4 c6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.e3 e6 5.Nf3.name: Semi-Slav Defence: Stonewall Defence
